scene.name: g1_indoor_v1
scene.description: Two rooms joined by a doorway, a table with red/blue/green blocks, a circular target zone, a 10 cm step, a 10 degree slope and a standing avatar.

tasks.goal: Walk to the table.
tasks.success: base within 0.6 m of table, 0 falls

tasks.goal: Walk to the table and stop.
tasks.success: within 0.6 m of table, base speed < 0.05 m/s for 3 s

tasks.goal: Go to the person and wave, then come back.
tasks.success: visited person within 1.2 m, wave completed, back within 0.5 m of start_pose

tasks.goal: Push the red block into the target zone.
tasks.success: block_red center inside target_zone

tasks.goal: Walk to the table and push the red block into the zone.
tasks.success: block_red center inside target_zone

tasks.goal: Push the blue block into the target zone, leave the red one.
tasks.success: block_blue in zone, block_red moved < 0.1 m

tasks.goal: Push both the red and the green blocks into the zone.
tasks.success: block_red and block_green in zone

tasks.goal: Step over the step and stand on the other side.
tasks.success: base past the step by > 0.3 m, 0 falls

tasks.goal: Walk up the slope.
tasks.success: base within 0.5 m of slope top, 0 falls

tasks.goal: Go to the other room.
tasks.success: base within 0.8 m of room_b_center

tasks.goal: Go to the other room, wave at the person, return.
tasks.success: visited person, wave completed, back within 0.5 m of start_pose

tasks.goal: Face the table.
tasks.success: heading error to table < 10 deg

tasks.goal: Turn around and walk back to where you started.
tasks.success: within 0.5 m of start_pose

tasks.goal: Stand still for 30 seconds.
tasks.success: no fall, base drift < 0.2 m

tasks.goal: Get up after being knocked down, then walk to the table.
tasks.success: starts prone/supine, standing within 10 s, then within 0.6 m of table

tasks.goal: Walk to the table; if you fall, get up and keep going.
tasks.success: within 0.6 m of table; any fall followed by get_up and re-plan

tasks.goal: Do the dance clip, then walk to the person.
tasks.success: motion completed without fall, within 1.2 m of person

tasks.goal: Wave at the person, then push the blue block into the zone.
tasks.success: wave completed, block_blue in zone

tasks.goal: Walk to the green block, then the table, then the person.
tasks.success: each waypoint reached in order within 0.8 m

tasks.goal: Go past the step, turn around, come back, and wave.
tasks.success: crossed step twice, 0 unrecovered falls, wave completed
